sources.title: Remotion transitions
sources.note: Official transition API includes fade, slide, wipe, zoomBlur, crossZoom and filmBurn presentations. Requires the compatible @remotion/transitions package.
sources.online_description: This package provides the `` component for transitioning between two scenes as well as timing presets.

sources.title: Remotion scene transitions
sources.note: TransitionSeries overlaps adjacent scenes. Timing is measured in frames; overlap reduces combined duration.
sources.online_description: The ` component lets you animate between absolutely positioned scenes. Between any two sequences, you can place a or a `.

sources.title: Remotion interpolate
sources.note: Use interpolate with explicit frame points and clamp behavior for bounded motion.
sources.online_description: Allows you to map a range of values to another using a concise syntax.

sources.title: Remotion spring
sources.note: Spring timing provides damped movement, useful only when observed in the reference.

sources.title: Remotion captions
sources.note: Captions require actual transcript timing or user-supplied subtitles; do not invent text.
sources.online_description: Learn how to add captions and subtitles to your Remotion videos.

sources.title: Remotion TikTok captions
sources.note: Token-page grouping creates TikTok-style caption timing; transcription is still required.
sources.online_description: Using this function, you can segment tokens to create "pages" of captions, as commonly seen on TikTok videos.

sources.title: Remotion audio visualization
sources.note: Audio visualizers use waveform/spectrum data. This does not automatically implement beat-synced cutting.
sources.online_description: Remotion has APIs for visualizing audio, for example for creating audiograms or music visualizers.

sources.title: Remotion using audio
sources.note: Video audio volume and timing should keep dialog intelligible; assess clipping after mixing.
sources.online_description: Remotion provides powerful capabilities for working with audio in your compositions.

sources.title: FFmpeg filtergraph reference
sources.note: Official reference for filter graphs, xfade, overlay, zoompan and audio filters. Validate on a test render before enabling.

sources.title: OpenCV optical flow
sources.note: Optical flow estimates movement between images; not a full automatic object-aware compositor.

sources.title: OpenCV template matching
sources.note: Template matching can localize known templates; limitations include scale and occlusion.

sources.title: Remotion motion blur
sources.note: HTML-in-canvas blur or camera motion blur can smooth graphic movement; not yet wired into this editor.
sources.online_description: To realize a realistic motion blur, a frame needs to be duplicated multiple times and blended together.

sources.title: Remotion animation utilities
sources.note: Transform helpers can build controlled kinetic typography and graphic motion.
sources.online_description: Functions that support you in animating CSS styles.

sources.note: Word highlighting and styled caption sequences require real aligned transcript tokens.
